note: Authored by the project lead from reports captured on this project's bench with probe/test/run.mjs (see probe/test/captured-*.json). Observed 2026-11-09 on macOS arm64: Chromium 149 (Chrome for Testing, headless) and Firefox 159 (headless); main world, iframe and worker agreed in both. Only dimensions that differed between the two engines are listed. `math` was identical in both and `error_capture_stack_trace` was true in both, so neither is used. One version of each engine is thin evidence: older releases may word the error differently and would then be flagged. Observed 2026-11-10: Safari 27.2 on macOS 27.2 (by hand, with run.mjs manual); main world, iframe and worker agreed. WebKit alone sets `error_line`, so it is listed for WebKit. Its `math` differs from the other two in the last digit, but it may depend on the CPU and the system library, so it is not used. Verified the same day: Safari 27.2, DuckDuckGo 27.2 and Firefox Focus 155 on an iPhone (iOS 27.2) ran the probe through the gateway with no engine_mismatch. Do not add values from memory.
